```{r}
##########################################################
# Xenium: SnC + cell type annotation + plots
# (parallel to your 4i / CODEX workflow)
##########################################################
load("/home/ext_han_yeaeun_mayo_edu/skin_mapping/data/260311.RData")

save.image("/home/ext_han_yeaeun_mayo_edu/skin_mapping/data/260311.RData") #260516

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(pheatmap)
})

# ---- set working dir (edit if needed) ----
setwd("//mfad/researchmn/PHYS-BIOMED-ENG/PASSOS/SHARED/Yeaeun/ana/skin_mapping_2")

# ---- your Xenium Seurat object ----
# assume it exists in the environment as: hsskin.ST
# (if you need to load it, add: hsskin.ST <- readRDS("path/to/xenium.rds"))

# =========================
# 1) Choose assay/layer conventions
# =========================
# positivity calls: use Xenium counts (true detection)
assay_pos  <- if ("Xenium" %in% Assays(hsskin.ST)) "Xenium" else DefaultAssay(hsskin.ST)
layer_pos  <- "counts"

# plotting expression: use SCT normalized (smooth distribution)
assay_plot <- if ("SCT" %in% Assays(hsskin.ST)) "SCT" else DefaultAssay(hsskin.ST)
layer_plot <- "data"

# =========================
# 3) Marker mapping (Xenium gene symbols)
# =========================

arrest_genes <- c(
  "CDKN2A","CDKN1A","CDKN1B","CDKN2B", "CDKN1C", "CDKN2C"
)

prolif_genes <- c(
  "MKI67","PCNA","CENPF","CENPV","UBE2C","CDK1","STMN1","ORC6"
)

sasp_genes <- c(
"CCL11","CCL13","CCL14","CCL15","CCL16","CCL19","CCL2","CCL20","CCL21",
"CCL26","CCL28","CCL3","CCL3L1","CCL4","CCL5","CCL7","CCL8",
"CXCL1","CXCL10","CXCL11","CXCL12","CXCL13","CXCL14","CXCL16","CXCL2",
"CXCL3","CXCL5","CXCL6","CXCL9",
"IL12B","IL13","IL15","IL18","IL1A","IL1B","IL2","IL23A","IL4","IL5","IL6",
"MMP12","MMP9","MMP3",
"VEGFA","TNF","TGFB1","CSF1","EGF","FGF2","IFNB1","CMKLR1"
)

Antiapoptotic_genes <- c(
  "BCL2"
)

get_bin <- function(obj, genes, assay = "Xenium", layer = "counts") {
  if (length(genes) == 0) return(matrix(FALSE, 0, ncol(obj), dimnames = list(NULL, colnames(obj))))
  LayerData(obj, assay = assay, layer = layer)[genes, , drop = FALSE] > 0
}

hsskin.ST$arrest_score  <- colMeans(get_bin(hsskin.ST, arrest_genes, assay_pos, layer_pos))
hsskin.ST$prolif_score  <- colMeans(get_bin(hsskin.ST, prolif_genes, assay_pos, layer_pos))
hsskin.ST$sasp_score    <- colMeans(get_bin(hsskin.ST, sasp_genes, assay_pos, layer_pos))
hsskin.ST$Antiapoptotic_score <- colMeans(get_bin(hsskin.ST, Antiapoptotic_genes, assay_pos, layer_pos))



library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

df_scores <- hsskin.ST@meta.data %>%
  select(sample, arrest_score, prolif_score, sasp_score, Antiapoptotic_score) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(arrest_score, prolif_score, sasp_score, Antiapoptotic_score),
    names_to = "score_type",
    values_to = "score"
  )


ggplot(df_scores, aes(x = sample, y = score)) +
  geom_violin(fill = "grey80", color = "black", scale = "width") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.shape = NA) +
  facet_wrap(~score_type, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )


ggplot(df_scores, aes(x = sample, y = score, fill = sample)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~score_type, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  )





p16 <- get_pos(hsskin.ST, "CDKN2A", assay_pos, layer_pos)
p21 <- get_pos(hsskin.ST, "CDKN1A", assay_pos, layer_pos)

hsskin.ST$SnC_score <- with(
  hsskin.ST@meta.data,
  2*arrest_score + 1.5*sasp_score + 0.5*Antiapoptotic_score - 2*prolif_score
)

hsskin.ST$SnC_highconf <- ifelse(
  (p16 | p21) & sasp_score >= 0.10 & prolif_score == 0,
  "SnC+", "SnC-"
)

hsskin.ST$SnC_permissive <- ifelse(
  SnC_score >= 0.8,
  "SnC+", "SnC-"
)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(pheatmap)

# ----------------------------
# 1) Keep genes in desired order
# ----------------------------
ordered_genes <- c(arrest_genes, prolif_genes, sasp_genes, Antiapoptotic_genes)
ordered_genes <- ordered_genes[ordered_genes %in% rownames(hsskin.ST)]

# ----------------------------
# 2) Pull expression matrix
# ----------------------------
mat <- LayerData(
  hsskin.ST,
  assay = assay_pos,
  layer = layer_pos
)[ordered_genes, , drop = FALSE]

# ----------------------------
# 3) Sample vector
# ----------------------------
sample_vec <- hsskin.ST$sample
names(sample_vec) <- colnames(hsskin.ST)

sample_levels <- unique(sample_vec)

# ----------------------------
# 4) Fraction-positive per sample
# ----------------------------
sample_frac_pos <- sapply(sample_levels, function(s) {
  cells <- names(sample_vec)[sample_vec == s]
  rowMeans(mat[, cells, drop = FALSE] > 0)
})

sample_frac_pos <- as.matrix(sample_frac_pos)
rownames(sample_frac_pos) <- ordered_genes
colnames(sample_frac_pos) <- as.character(sample_levels)

# ----------------------------
# 5) Row annotation: gene module
# ----------------------------
row_annot <- data.frame(
  module = c(
    rep("Arrest", length(arrest_genes[arrest_genes %in% ordered_genes])),
    rep("Proliferation", length(prolif_genes[prolif_genes %in% ordered_genes])),
    rep("SASP", length(sasp_genes[sasp_genes %in% ordered_genes])),
    rep("Antiapoptotic", length(Antiapoptotic_genes[Antiapoptotic_genes %in% ordered_genes]))
  )
)
rownames(row_annot) <- ordered_genes

# ----------------------------
# 6) Column annotation: one row per sample
#    Edit these columns to match your metadata
# ----------------------------
meta_sample <- hsskin.ST@meta.data %>%
  select(sample) %>%          # change/add columns here
  distinct()

meta_sample <- as.data.frame(meta_sample)
rownames(meta_sample) <- meta_sample$sample
#meta_sample$sample <- NULL

# match order of heatmap columns
col_annot <- meta_sample[colnames(sample_frac_pos), , drop = FALSE]

# ----------------------------
# 7) Heatmap
# ----------------------------
pheatmap(
  sample_frac_pos,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  annotation_row = row_annot,
  annotation_col = col_annot,
  border_color = NA,
  scale = 'row',
  main = "Fraction of positive cells per sample"
)
```


```{r}
library(pheatmap)

# Extract the four scores from the metadata
score_data <- hsskin.ST@meta.data[, c("arrest_z", "sasp_z", "Antiapoptotic_z", "prolif_z")]

# Drop any NAs to ensure the math runs cleanly
score_data <- na.omit(score_data)

# Calculate the correlation matrix (Spearman is usually safer for single-cell scores)
cor_matrix <- cor(score_data, method = "spearman")



# Plot the heatmap
pheatmap(
  cor_matrix,
  display_numbers = TRUE,           # Prints the exact R value in the box
  fontsize_number = 12,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#08519c", "white", "#cc0b01"))(50), # Blue to White to Red
  breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 51), # Locks the scale strictly from -1 to 1
  main = "Spearman Correlation: Senescence Modules",
  angle_col = 45
)
```

```{r}
library(pheatmap)
library(Seurat)

# 1. Define the specific genes that make up each module
# (Using the exact Xenium gene symbols from your earlier code)
module_list <- list(
  Arrest = arrest_genes,         # p21, p16
  Proliferation = prolif_genes, 
  Antiapoptotic = c("BCL2"),              # Add others if you have them in the panel
  SASP = sasp_genes               # Your filtered list of 51 SASP genes
)

# Unlist to get a single vector of all target genes
all_target_genes <- unname(unlist(module_list))

# Ensure we only try to fetch genes that actually exist in the object's assay
all_target_genes <- intersect(all_target_genes, rownames(hsskin.ST[["Xenium"]]))

# 2. Extract the normalized expression data
# We use slot/layer = "data" because raw counts will artificially skew the correlation due to zeros
gene_expr_matrix <- FetchData(
  hsskin.ST, 
  vars = all_target_genes, 
  layer = "data" 
)

# 3. Calculate the Spearman correlation matrix
gene_cor_matrix <- cor(gene_expr_matrix, method = "spearman")

# 4. Build the annotation dataframe so pheatmap knows which gene belongs to which module
annotation_df <- data.frame(
  Module = rep(names(module_list), lengths(module_list))
)
# Match the rownames of the annotation to the gene names
rownames(annotation_df) <- unname(unlist(module_list))
# Filter it down to just the genes that were actually found in the object
annotation_df <- annotation_df[rownames(gene_cor_matrix), , drop = FALSE]

# 5. Define custom colors for the modules (optional, but looks cleaner)
ann_colors <- list(
  Module = c(
    Arrest = "#d95f02", 
    Proliferation = "#1b9e77", 
    Antiapoptotic = "#7570b3", 
    SASP = "#e7298a"
  )
)

pdf(file = "Gene_Correlation_Heatmap.pdf", width = 10, height = 10)

# 6. Plot the annotated heatmap
pheatmap(
  gene_cor_matrix,
  annotation_col = annotation_df,
  annotation_row = annotation_df,      # Adds the color track to both axes
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  show_rownames = TRUE,                
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 6,                    # Shrunk to fit all ~50 SASP genes
  fontsize_col = 6,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#08519c", "white", "#cc0b01"))(50),
  breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 51),
  main = "Gene-Level Correlation: Senescence Modules",
  treeheight_row = 20,                 # Shrinks the dendrogram lines slightly
  treeheight_col = 20
)

dev.off()
```


```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(GSVA)

expr_mat <- LayerData(hsskin.ST, assay = assay_pos, layer = layer_pos)

arrest_present  <- arrest_genes[arrest_genes %in% rownames(expr_mat)]
prolif_present  <- prolif_genes[prolif_genes %in% rownames(expr_mat)]
sasp_present    <- sasp_genes[sasp_genes %in% rownames(expr_mat)]
Antiapoptotic_present <- Antiapoptotic_genes[Antiapoptotic_genes %in% rownames(expr_mat)]

snc_sets <- list(
  Arrest  = arrest_present,
  Prolif  = prolif_present,
  SASP    = sasp_present,
  Antiapoptotic = Antiapoptotic_present
)

# ssGSEA
ssgsea_scores <- gsva(
  expr = as.matrix(expr_mat),
  gset.idx.list = snc_sets,
  method = "ssgsea",
  kcdf = "Poisson",
  abs.ranking = TRUE,
  verbose = FALSE
)

hsskin.ST$Arrest_ssgsea  <- ssgsea_scores["Arrest", ]
hsskin.ST$Prolif_ssgsea  <- ssgsea_scores["Prolif", ]
hsskin.ST$SASP_ssgsea    <- ssgsea_scores["SASP", ]
hsskin.ST$Antiapoptotic_ssgsea <- ssgsea_scores["Antiapoptotic", ]

hsskin.ST$SnC_ssgsea <- (
  hsskin.ST$Arrest_ssgsea +
  hsskin.ST$SASP_ssgsea +
  hsskin.ST$Antiapoptotic_ssgsea -
  hsskin.ST$Prolif_ssgsea
) / 4

# GSVA
gsva_scores <- gsva(
  expr = as.matrix(expr_mat),
  gset.idx.list = snc_sets,
  method = "gsva",
  kcdf = "Poisson",
  verbose = FALSE
)

hsskin.ST$Arrest_gsva  <- gsva_scores["Arrest", ]
hsskin.ST$Prolif_gsva  <- gsva_scores["Prolif", ]
hsskin.ST$SASP_gsva    <- gsva_scores["SASP", ]
hsskin.ST$Antiapoptotic_gsva <- gsva_scores["Antiapoptotic", ]

hsskin.ST$SnC_gsva <- (
  hsskin.ST$Arrest_gsva +
  hsskin.ST$SASP_gsva +
  hsskin.ST$Antiapoptotic_gsva -
  hsskin.ST$Prolif_gsva
) / 4


DefaultAssay(hsskin.ST) <- assay_pos
hsskin.ST <- NormalizeData(hsskin.ST, assay = assay_pos, verbose = FALSE)


# control pool = all genes in Xenium panel
pool_genes <- rownames(hsskin.ST[[assay_pos]])

# AddModuleScore for each module
hsskin.ST <- AddModuleScore(
  object = hsskin.ST,
  features = list(arrest_present),
  assay = assay_pos,
  pool = pool_genes,
  name = "Arrest_AMS",
  ctrl = 3,
  nbin = 5,
  seed = 1
)

hsskin.ST <- AddModuleScore(
  object = hsskin.ST,
  features = list(prolif_present),
  assay = assay_pos,
  pool = pool_genes,
  name = "Prolif_AMS",
  ctrl = 3,
  nbin = 5,
  seed = 1
)

hsskin.ST <- AddModuleScore(
  object = hsskin.ST,
  features = list(sasp_present),
  assay = assay_pos,
  pool = pool_genes,
  name = "SASP_AMS",
  ctrl = 3,
  nbin = 5,
  seed = 1
)

hsskin.ST <- AddModuleScore(
  object = hsskin.ST,
  features = list(Antiapoptotic_present),
  assay = assay_pos,
  pool = pool_genes,
  name = "Antiapoptotic_AMS",
  ctrl = 3,
  nbin = 5,
  seed = 1
)

hsskin.ST$SnC_AddModuleScore <- (
  hsskin.ST$Arrest_AMS1 +
  hsskin.ST$SASP_AMS1 +
  hsskin.ST$Antiapoptotic_AMS1 -
  hsskin.ST$Prolif_AMS1
) / 4

hsskin.ST$SnC_binary <- ifelse(
  hsskin.ST$SnC_AddModuleScore > 0,
  "SnC+",
  "SnC-"
)

df_snc <- hsskin.ST@meta.data %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(SnC_fraction = mean(SnC_binary == "SnC+"))

ggplot(df_snc, aes(x = sample, y = SnC_fraction)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
hsskin.ST$arrest_z  <- as.numeric(scale(hsskin.ST$arrest_score))
hsskin.ST$prolif_z  <- as.numeric(scale(hsskin.ST$prolif_score))
hsskin.ST$sasp_z    <- as.numeric(scale(hsskin.ST$sasp_score))
hsskin.ST$Antiapoptotic_z <- as.numeric(scale(hsskin.ST$Antiapoptotic_score))

hsskin.ST$arrest_flag  <- hsskin.ST$arrest_z  > 0
hsskin.ST$sasp_flag    <- hsskin.ST$sasp_z    > 0
#hsskin.ST$Antiapoptotic_flag <- hsskin.ST$Antiapoptotic_z > 0
hsskin.ST$prolif_flag  <- hsskin.ST$prolif_z  < 0

hsskin.ST$SnC_votes <-
  hsskin.ST$arrest_flag +
  hsskin.ST$sasp_flag +
  hsskin.ST$prolif_flag

hsskin.ST$SnC_binary <- ifelse(hsskin.ST$SnC_votes == 3, "SnC+", "SnC-")

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(hsskin.ST@meta.data, aes(x = arrest_z)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50) +
  theme_classic()

library(dplyr)

df_snc_sample <- hsskin.ST@meta.data %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(
    SnC_fraction = mean(SnC_binary == "SnC+")
  )

ggplot(df_snc_sample, aes(x = sample, y = SnC_fraction)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))


################################
# Trying a continuous composite score
################################
# Create a continuous metric for senescence
hsskin.ST$Composite_SnC_Score <- 
  hsskin.ST$arrest_z + 
  hsskin.ST$sasp_z + 
  hsskin.ST$Antiapoptotic_z - 
  hsskin.ST$prolif_z

# Find the value at the 95th percentile
snc_cutoff <- quantile(hsskin.ST$Composite_SnC_Score, probs = 0.97, na.rm = TRUE)

# Print the cutoff value to your console to verify
print(paste("Top 1% threshold is:", round(snc_cutoff, 3)))

hsskin.ST$SnC_binary <- ifelse(
  hsskin.ST$Composite_SnC_Score >= snc_cutoff, 
  "SnC+", 
  "SnC-"
)

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Plot the distribution of the composite score with a line at the 5% cutoff
ggplot(hsskin.ST@meta.data, aes(x = Composite_SnC_Score)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "gray70", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = snc_cutoff, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = snc_cutoff + 0.1, y = Inf, label = "Top 1%", 
           vjust = 1.5, color = "red") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(title = "Composite Senescence Score Distribution",
       x = "Composite Z-Score (Arrest + SASP + AntiApop - Prolif)",
       y = "Cell Count")

# Plot the sample-level SnC fractions (should average around 0.05 across the dataset)
df_snc_sample <- hsskin.ST@meta.data %>%
  group_by(sample, age) %>%
  summarise(
    SnC_fraction = mean(SnC_binary == "SnC+", na.rm = TRUE)
  )

ggplot(df_snc_sample, aes(x = sample, y = SnC_fraction)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.01, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Fraction of Top 1% SnC+ Cells per Sample",
       y = "SnC+ Fraction",
       x = "Sample")

ggplot(df_snc_sample, aes(x = age, y = SnC_fraction)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.01, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# 1. Calculate the pooled fraction for the main bars
# (Total SnC+ cells per age / Total cells per age)
df_pooled <- hsskin.ST@meta.data %>%
  filter(!is.na(sample) & !is.na(age)) %>%
  group_by(age) %>%
  summarise(
    pooled_fraction = sum(SnC_binary == "SnC+", na.rm = TRUE) / n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2. Calculate the individual sample fractions for the dots
df_samples <- hsskin.ST@meta.data %>%
  filter(!is.na(sample) & !is.na(age)) %>%
  group_by(age, sample) %>%
  summarise(
    sample_fraction = sum(SnC_binary == "SnC+", na.rm = TRUE) / n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 3. Plot the pooled bars with the sample dots overlaid
blue_col <- "#296d9e"
ymax <- max(df_samples$sample_fraction, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.15

ggplot() +
  # Draw the main bars using the pooled data
  geom_col(
    data = df_pooled, 
    aes(x = age, y = pooled_fraction),
    fill = blue_col, color = "black", width = 0.6
  ) +
  # Overlay the dots using the individual sample data
  geom_point(
    data = df_samples, 
    aes(x = age, y = sample_fraction),
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.07, seed = 42),
    size = 3, color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, ymax),
    breaks = pretty(c(0, ymax), n = 4),
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.1),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  labs(
    #title = "Pooled Fraction of Top 1% SnC+ Cells by Age",
    x = NULL, 
    y = "SnC+ Fraction"
  )
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggpubr)
library(patchwork)

# Define the features and the statistical comparison
features <- c("arrest_z", "sasp_z", "Antiapoptotic_z", "prolif_z")
my_comparisons <- list(c("Young", "Old"))

# Loop through each feature, build the VlnPlot, and add the ggplot layers
plot_list <- lapply(features, function(feature) {
  
  # Base Seurat Plot
  p <- VlnPlot(
    hsskin.ST,
    features = feature,
    group.by = "age",
    cols = c("#9ecae1", "#08519c"),
    pt.size = 0
  ) 
  
  # Add the crossbar and p-value on top
  p <- p + 
    stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.3, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    stat_compare_means(comparisons = my_comparisons, method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.signif") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.2))) + # <-- Adds 20% padding to the top
    theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")
  
  return(p)
})

# Combine the individual plots back into a 2x2 grid
wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 2)
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

plot_xenium_snc_custom <- function(
  obj,
  sample_id,
  sample_col = "sample",
  snc_col = "SnC_binary",
  coord_slot = "fov",
  bg_color = "grey88",
  snc_color = "#D73027",
  bg_size = 0.05,
  snc_size = 0.12,
  flip_y = TRUE
) {
  # coordinates
  coords <- obj@images[[coord_slot]]$centroids@coords %>%
    as.data.frame()
  coords$cell_id <- rownames(coords)
  
  # metadata
  meta <- obj@meta.data %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(cell_id = rownames(.)) %>%
    select(cell_id, all_of(sample_col), all_of(snc_col))
  
  # merge and subset sample
  df <- left_join(coords, meta, by = "cell_id") %>%
    filter(.data[[sample_col]] == sample_id)
  
  # guess x/y column names
  x_col <- "x"
  y_col <- "y"
  
  if (is.na(x_col) || is.na(y_col)) {
    stop("Could not identify x/y columns in hsskin.ST@images$fov$centroids@coords")
  }
  
  snc_frac <- mean(df[[snc_col]] == "SnC+", na.rm = TRUE)
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_point(
      data = df %>% filter(.data[[snc_col]] != "SnC+"),
      aes_string(x = x_col, y = y_col),
      color = bg_color,
      size = bg_size,
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = df %>% filter(.data[[snc_col]] == "SnC+"),
      aes_string(x = x_col, y = y_col),
      color = snc_color,
      size = snc_size,
      alpha = 0.95
    ) +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_void() +
    labs(title = paste0(sample_id, " (", round(snc_frac * 100, 1), "% SnC+)")) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
    )
  
  if (flip_y) {
    p <- p + scale_y_reverse()
  }
  
  p
}


sample_ids <- unique(hsskin.ST$sample)

plot_list <- lapply(sample_ids, function(s) {
  plot_xenium_snc_custom(
    obj = hsskin.ST,
    sample_id = s,
    sample_col = "sample",
    snc_col = "SnC_binary",
    coord_slot = "fov"
  )
})

wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 2)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

plot_xenium_snc <- function(obj, sample_id, fov_name) {

  coords <- obj@images[[fov_name]]$centroids@coords
  coords <- as.data.frame(coords)

  meta <- obj@meta.data %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    filter(sample == sample_id)

  if (nrow(coords) != nrow(meta)) {
    stop(paste("Coordinate / metadata mismatch for", sample_id))
  }

  df <- cbind(coords, meta)

  snc_frac <- mean(df$SnC_binary == "SnC+")

  ggplot() +
    geom_point(
      data = df %>% filter(SnC_binary != "SnC+"),
      aes(x = x, y = y),
      color = "grey90",
      size = 0.05
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = df %>% filter(SnC_binary == "SnC+"),
      aes(x = x, y = y),
      color = "#D73027",
      size = 0.12
    ) +
    coord_fixed() +
    scale_y_reverse() +
    theme_void() +
    labs(
      title = paste0(sample_id, " (", round(snc_frac * 100,1), "% SnC+)")
    ) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
}

library(patchwork)

plot_list <- lapply(1:nrow(sample_fov_map), function(i) {

  sample_id <- sample_fov_map$sample[i]
  fov_name  <- sample_fov_map$fov[i]

  plot_xenium_snc(
    obj = hsskin.ST,
    sample_id = sample_id,
    fov_name = fov_name
  )
})

wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 4)

for (i in 1:nrow(sample_fov_map)) {

  sample_id <- sample_fov_map$sample[i]
  fov_name  <- sample_fov_map$fov[i]

  p <- plot_xenium_snc(
    obj = hsskin.ST,

    fov_name = fov_name
  )

  ggsave(
    paste0(sample_id, "_SnC_map.png"),
    plot = p,
    width = 5,
    height = 5,
    dpi = 300
  )
```

```{r}
  filter(!is.na(SnC_binary) & !is.na(cell_type_major)) %>%
  group_by(SnC_binary, cell_type_major) %>%

  group_by(SnC_binary) %>%

  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Major Cell Type Composition: SnC+ vs SnC-",
    x = "Senescence Status",
    y = "Proportion of Cells",
    fill = "Major Cell Type"
  )
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)

# 1. Plot UMAPs: Seurat Clusters vs. SnC Phenotype
# (Assuming your clusters are stored in 'seurat_clusters' or 'cell_type_major')
cluster_col <- "SCT_snn_res.0.3" # Change this to "cell_type_major" if you prefer
cluster_col <- "cell_type_final"

p_umap_cluster <- DimPlot(hsskin.ST, reduction = "umap", group.by = cluster_col, label = TRUE, pt.size = 0.5) + 
  ggtitle("Transcriptomic Clusters") + theme(legend.position = "none")

p_umap_snc <- DimPlot(hsskin.ST, reduction = "umap", group.by = "snc", 
                      cols = c("SnC-" = "gray80", "SnC+" = "#cc0b01"), pt.size = 0.5) + 
  ggtitle("Senescent Cells (SnC+)")

# Display UMAPs
print(p_umap_cluster | p_umap_snc)

# 2. Calculate SnC fraction per cluster
df_cluster_snc <- hsskin.ST@meta.data %>%
  filter(!is.na(!!sym(cluster_col)) & !is.na(snc)) %>%
  group_by(!!sym(cluster_col)) %>%
  summarise(
    total_cells = n(),
    snc_cells = sum(snc == "SnC+"),
    snc_fraction = snc_cells / total_cells,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(snc_fraction))


p_enrich <- ggplot(df_cluster_snc, aes(x = snc_fraction, y = reorder(!!sym(cluster_col), snc_fraction))) +
  geom_col(fill = "#296d9e", color = "black", width = 0.7) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold")) + # Updated theme for y-axis text
  labs(x = "% SnC+ Cells", y = "Cluster", title = "SnC Burden by Cluster")

print(p_enrich)

ggsave("results/xenium_snc_burden.pdf", plot = p_enrich, width = 3.6, height = 5, dpi = 500)


# Programmatically get the name of the cluster with the highest SnC fraction
top_snc_cluster <- as.character(df_cluster_snc[[cluster_col]][1])
cat("Finding markers for the top SnC+ cluster:", top_snc_cluster, "\n")

Idents(hsskin.ST) <- cluster_col

top_cluster_degs <- FindMarkers(
  hsskin.ST,
  ident.1 = top_snc_cluster,
  only.pos = TRUE,
  min.pct = 0.1,
  logfc.threshold = 0.1
)

# View top 10 genes defining this cluster
head(top_cluster_degs, 10)

# 1. Create a hybrid identity column: "Cluster_Phenotype"
hsskin.ST$cluster_snc <- paste0(hsskin.ST@meta.data[[cluster_col]], "_", hsskin.ST$snc)
Idents(hsskin.ST) <- "cluster_snc"

# 2. Define the two groups to compare
ident_snc_plus  <- paste0(top_snc_cluster, "_SnC+")
ident_snc_minus <- paste0(top_snc_cluster, "_SnC-")

# 3. Find DEGs driven by the senescence state, controlling for cell type
snc_specific_degs <- FindMarkers(
  hsskin.ST,
  ident.1 = ident_snc_plus,
  ident.2 = ident_snc_minus,
  min.pct = 0.1,
  logfc.threshold = 0.1
)

# Sort by lowest adjusted p-value and view
snc_specific_degs <- snc_specific_degs[order(snc_specific_degs$p_val_adj), ]
head(snc_specific_degs, 10)

# Optional: Visualize the top DEG
top_gene <- rownames(snc_specific_degs)[1]
VlnPlot(hsskin.ST, features = top_gene, idents = c(ident_snc_plus, ident_snc_minus))

DimPlot(
  hsskin.ST, 
  reduction = "umap", 
  group.by = "cell_type_major", 
  label = TRUE, 
  repel = TRUE,
  pt.size = 0.5
) + 
  ggtitle("Annotated Cell Types") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") # Hiding the legend since labels are on the plot
```

```{r}
Idents(hsskin.ST) <- cluster_col 

# 2. Find positive markers for every cluster compared to all other cells
all_cluster_markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  hsskin.ST,
  only.pos = TRUE,         # Only find upregulated genes
  min.pct = 0.1,           # Gene must be expressed in at least 10% of cells in the cluster
  logfc.threshold = 0.1    # Lower threshold for targeted Xenium data
)

# 3. Group by cluster and extract the top 5 genes per cluster
top5_per_cluster <- all_cluster_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(n = 5, order_by = avg_log2FC) %>%
  ungroup()

# View the results in the console
print(top5_per_cluster[, c("cluster", "gene", "avg_log2FC", "p_val_adj")])

hsskin.ST <- ScaleData(hsskin.ST, features = rownames(hsskin.ST))

# 4. Visualize the top 5 genes across all clusters using a Heatmap
p_heatmap <- DoHeatmap(hsskin.ST, features = top5_per_cluster$gene) + 
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)) +
  ggtitle("Top 5 DEGs per Cluster")

print(p_heatmap)

p_dotplot <- DotPlot(hsskin.ST, features = unique(top5_per_cluster$gene)) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5)) +
  ggtitle("Top 5 DEGs per Cluster")

print(p_dotplot)

# 1. Define the exact clusters you want to focus on (as characters)
target_clusters <- c("5", "6", "2", "3")
target_clusters <- c("M2 Macrophages", "CD4+ Naive T Cells", "CD8+ Exhausted T Cells", "Corneocytes", "Hair Follicles")

# 2. Filter your previously calculated top 5 list to ONLY these clusters
filtered_top5 <- top5_per_cluster %>%
  filter(cluster %in% target_clusters)

# 3. Extract the unique gene names for the plot
target_genes <- unique(filtered_top5$gene)

ordered_idents <- factor(target_clusters, levels = c("5", "6", "2", "3"))
ordered_idents <- factor(target_clusters, levels = c("M2 Macrophages", "CD4+ Naive T Cells", "CD8+ Exhausted T Cells", "Corneocytes", "Hair Follicles"))

# 3. Generate the DotPlot using the pre-ordered factor

  hsskin.ST, 
  features = target_genes, 
  idents = ordered_idents
) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5)) +
  labs(y = "Cluster", title = "Top 5 DEGs by Clusters")+ scale_y_discrete(limits = c("M2 Macrophages", "CD4+ Naive T Cells", "CD8+ Exhausted T Cells", "Corneocytes", "Hair Follicles")) +
  scale_color_gradientn(
    colours = c("lightgrey", "#9ecae1", "#3182bd", "#08519c")
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# OPTION B: The Subsetted Heatmap
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# For a heatmap, the safest way to drop the other clusters from the X-axis 
# is to temporarily subset the Seurat object inside the plotting function.
# (Make sure you ran ScaleData(hsskin.ST, features = target_genes) previously!)

p_heatmap_sub <- DoHeatmap(
  subset(hsskin.ST, idents = target_clusters), 
  features = target_genes
) + 
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)) +
  ggtitle("Top 5 DEGs: Clusters 5, 4, 3, 9, 15")
```
